t: What Foundation Engineering Database Is All About
title: What Foundation Engineering Database Is All About
description: Foundations transfer loads to soil that can take them: spread footings on good soil, piles through bad to good, mats for heavy/soft, caissons for bridges. Bearing capacity (Terzaghi) vs settlement — settlement usually governs. The Leaning Tower (Pisa) is differential settlement made famous; Mexico City's lakebed amplifies both settlement and shaking. Investigate the soil before designing the foundation. This database is the complete foundation record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
